item.title: Golding: LSU-bound coaches ‘have every opportunity’ to stay with Ole Miss in CFP semis and beyond
item.description: Ole Miss head coach Pete Golding told reporters during Saturday’s Fiesta Bowl press conference that assistants following former head coach Lane Kiffin to LSU “will have every opportunity” to continue coaching for the Rebels in the College Football Playoff semifinals and beyond. The post Golding: LSU-bound coaches ‘have every opportunity’ to stay with Ole Miss in CFP semis and beyond appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Owls’ teams knock off Lyon College late in climactic finishes
item.description: After a long break away from the hardwood, MUW’s basketball teams leaped back into action over the weekend in winning fashion over Lyon College at Pohl Gym with both squads snapping losing streaks as St. Louis Intercollegiate Athletics Conference play heats up in the new year. The post Owls’ teams knock off Lyon College late in climactic finishes appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Our View: America’s 250th comes at the right time
item.description: By now, saying our nation is bitterly divided has almost become a cliche, as obvious as noting that the sky is blue. Each news cycle seems to offer something new that further polarizes the people and inflames passions to the point that we are tempted to see each other as enemies. The post Our View: America’s 250th comes at the right time appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Tesla loses title as world’s biggest electric vehicle maker as sales fall for second year in a row
item.description: Tesla lost its crown as the world’s bestselling electric vehicle maker on Friday as a customer revolt over Elon Musk’s right-wing politics, expiring U.S. tax breaks for buyers and stiff overseas competition pushed sales down for a second year in a row. The post Tesla loses title as world’s biggest electric vehicle maker as sales fall for second year in a row appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Man who broke windows at Vance’s Ohio home is detained, the Secret Service says
item.description: A man who broke windows at Vice President JD Vance’s Ohio home and caused other property damage was detained early Monday, the U.S. Secret Service said. The post Man who broke windows at Vance’s Ohio home is detained, the Secret Service says appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Career highs for Hubbard, Epps help Bulldogs to OT win at Texas
item.description: The lights were not too bright for Mississippi State on Saturday as they began their SEC campaign with a shootout in Austin. The post Career highs for Hubbard, Epps help Bulldogs to OT win at Texas appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Possumhaw: The Cleaning Woman
item.description: Back in the 2000’s I wrote a few short stories published in short story books. Since I mentioned a few New Year’s Resolutions last week, I thought I’d share an excerpt about my friend Margaret. The post Possumhaw: The Cleaning Woman appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Bulldogs battered by No. 8 Oklahoma in first SEC road test
item.description: The Mississippi State women’s basketball team suffered its first SEC defeat in Oklahoma on Sunday, the second loss of the 2025-26 campaign. The post Bulldogs battered by No. 8 Oklahoma in first SEC road test appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: US expands list of countries whose citizens must pay up to $15,000 bonds to apply for visas
item.description: The Trump administration has added seven countries, including five in Africa, to the list of nations whose passport holders are required to post bonds of up to $15,000 to apply to enter the United States. The post US expands list of countries whose citizens must pay up to $15,000 bonds to apply for visas appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Maduro says ‘I was captured’ as he pleads not guilty to drug trafficking charges
item.description: A defiant Nicolás Maduro declared himself “the president of my country” as he protested his capture and pleaded not guilty on Monday to the federal drug trafficking charges that the Trump administration used to justify removing him from power in Venezuela. The post Maduro says ‘I was captured’ as he pleads not guilty to drug trafficking charges appeared first on The Dispatch.
